title: Scatter tier configuration — config/scatter-tiers.json
description: Defines how scatters are counted, the three mandatory feature tiers (3 scatters = feature, 4 = super_feature, 5+ = ultimate_feature), retrigger rules, and scatter anticipation behavior. Default counting rule is initial-grid: cascaded and copied scatters do not count. Final values must be validated by the approved math model.

countingRule.description: Which grid states contribute scatters toward a trigger. initial-grid: only the initial paid-spin result counts (default). include-cascades: scatters landing during cascades also count. include-copied: cascaded AND copied/transformed scatters count.

countCascadedScatters.description: Whether scatters that land during cascades count toward the trigger total. Must be false when countingRule is initial-grid; must be true when countingRule is include-cascades or include-copied.

countCopiedScatters.description: Whether scatters created by copy/transform mechanics count toward the trigger total. Must be false unless countingRule is include-copied.

tiers.description: Exactly the three mandatory tiers, in ascending scatter order: feature (3 scatters), super_feature (4), ultimate_feature (5+). Public names are themed; internal tierIds never change.

fiveOrMoreUsesUltimateTier.description: When true (default), any count of 5 or more scatters awards the ultimate_feature tier; extra scatters beyond 5 award no separate tier (extraScatterBonus may still add value).

retrigger.description: How scatters landing inside an active feature retrigger additional rounds. Caps are mandatory: no unbounded liability.

allowed.description: Whether retriggers are possible at all during features.

scattersRequired.description: Minimum scatters that must land in a single feature round to award a retrigger.

capPerFeature.description: Hard maximum number of retriggers per feature instance. 0 means retriggers are disabled in math even if allowed is true.

anticipation.description: Scatter anticipation presentation (slowed reels, tension audio). Presentation only: never changes the committed outcome.

enabled.description: Whether anticipation presentation plays when a trigger is possible.

triggersAtScatters.description: Number of scatters already visible that arms anticipation on the remaining reels (typically 2).

scattersPayIndependently.description: Optional: whether scatter combinations award a direct pay in addition to triggering features. Pays are defined in the paytable.

scattersSubstituteAsWild.description: Optional: whether SCATTER also substitutes as WILD in line/ways evaluation. Default false.

scattersPersistDuringCascades.description: Optional: whether landed scatters remain in place while cascades resolve around them. Default true.

allowedReels.description: Optional: zero-based reel (column) indices that may contain scatters. Omit to allow all reels.

items.description: Zero-based reel index, left to right.

extraScatterBonus.description: Optional: additional award for each scatter beyond the ultimate_feature threshold (e.g. +2 rounds per extra scatter).

enabled.description: Whether scatters beyond the ultimate threshold add extra value.

extraRoundsPerScatter.description: Feature rounds added per scatter beyond the ultimate_feature scattersRequired.

extraStartingMultiplier100.description: Starting-multiplier increase per extra scatter, in integer hundredths (x100 fixed point; 50 = +0.5x).

tierId.description: Canonical internal tier identifier. Never renamed; public names are themed separately.

modifierId.description: snake_case id of a feature modifier defined in config/features.json for the same tier.

tier.description: One scatter tier: the internal id, the scatter count that awards it, its themed public name, and the entry package the player receives.

tierId.description: Internal tier id: feature (3 scatters), super_feature (4), ultimate_feature (5+).

scattersRequired.description: Exact scatter count that awards this tier (3, 4, or 5). With fiveOrMoreUsesUltimateTier, counts above the ultimate threshold still award ultimate_feature.

publicName.description: Themed, player-facing name of this bonus tier (original; never a trademarked mechanic name).

entry.description: What the player receives on entering this tier. Tiers must be materially different in math and presentation, not just rounds or title.

rounds.description: Initial number of feature rounds (free spins / respins) awarded.

startingMultiplier100.description: Starting win multiplier in integer hundredths (x100 fixed point; 100 = 1x, 250 = 2.5x).

modifiers.description: Ids of the modifiers active from entry, each defined for this tier in config/features.json.
